summary: Phase 2 Family — 3-role visibility (parent/teen/child) + 'Family Protection' checklist row. Backend pytest (12/12 PASSED) and full Playwright UI coverage for all 3 role views, the 3-role join toggle, and the new Protection Status row.

integration_issues.issue: When a device is NOT in a family, the check-family row shows a Fix button as required, but clicking it only shows a sonner toast ('Open Family from the dashboard…') instead of routing to the Family screen. The other Fix buttons act in-place (request permission), so this is acceptable, but a one-tap deep-link to the Family screen would match parity with open-family-btn in Settings.

action_items: (Optional polish) Wire fix-family in SecurityChecklist to actually navigate to the Family screen (e.g. dispatch a 'navigate-family' event consumed by App.js, the same pattern used by open-family-btn / tile-family) instead of only toasting.
critical_code_review_comments: security_engine.py /family/members visibility logic is clean and correct: parents -> all + locations + manage; teens -> non-parents + locations; children -> non-parents + NO locations. Manually verified that teen/child sets show_locations and can_manage flags, and that last_location is nulled out at the API boundary for children rather than at the UI (good defence-in-depth).

FamilyTracking.js SiblingView reuses FamilyMap only when role==='teen' and there are located siblings — children correctly get a list-only view. data-testids family-sibling-view, family-role-parent/teen/child, family-code-card, family-map, family-members, family-member are all present.
SecurityChecklist.openFamily only fires a toast; consider real navigation to keep the 'Fix' contract consistent with the other rows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (parent, teen, child, checklist, role toggle)

test_credentials: Setup via /api/security/setup with access_code=2580, recovery_code=rec22 (per problem statement). Calculator cover unlock: 2580 then =.
seed_data_creation: Each Playwright run creates fresh devices: famDad_<ts>, famTeen_<ts>, famKid_<ts>, lone_<ts>. All cleaned up implicitly (timestamped IDs); backend pytest uses TEST_fam_*_<ts> prefixes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression for the 3-role family visibility lives in /app/backend/tests/test_family_tracking.py (12 tests, 4 classes: create/join, parent, teen, child + edges). For Playwright role testing, addInitScript('dm_device_id', ...) BEFORE page.goto, then dismiss the marketing landing via 'Try the Demo', and unlock the calculator cover by pressing 2,5,8,0,= using data-testid=calc-key-<n> / calc-key-equals. After unlock, dashboard tiles appear (tile-family, tile-status). To set up teen/child views, pre-seed the device via /api/security/setup, then /api/security/family/join + /api/security/recovery/locate before visiting the UI. Only known nit: fix-family does not navigate.
rca of the issue: n/a — no functional bug. Single optional-polish item documented above (fix-family deep-link).
